concepts.gloss_en: Perfection/completeness of the holy tongue (a state/quality OF the holy tongue, not the tongue itself); enables knowing the letters in every thing and interpreting dreams (Torah lm1:19)
The holy tongue (Hebrew) itself, the language in which the world was created; identified with Chava/the woman/dibbur — the bare object, not its perfection

members.note: representative; bare construct head, distinct from שלמות לשון הקדש (rule 4: a state about X is not X)

concepts.gloss_en: Perfection of speech, which is (an aspect of) the holy tongue — construct head is שלמות הדבור (perfection of SPEECH), locally equated to לשון הקדש only in Torah lm2:2; distinct from שלמות לשון הקדש of lm1:19 (different construct head, different Torah)

members.form: שלמות הדבור שהוא בחינת לשון הקדש
members.note: same phrase in same Torah/passage; differs only by inserting בחינת ('aspect of') — same referent, minor rephrasing

notes: Under-merged deliberately. שלמות לשון הקדש (lm1:19) and שלמות הדבור (lm2:2) are both 'perfection', but their construct heads differ (holy-tongue vs speech) and the equation speech=holy-tongue holds only locally in lm2:2 — kept separate per rules 3 and 4. Bare לשון הקדש kept apart from its 'perfection' forms per rule 4.
